changes_made.explanation: Added 'Pivot language Stabilizer captions' to outputs since the paper extensively evaluates the quality of these English captions generated by PLuGS models
Removed 'BLEU-4' since all BLEU variants should be normalized to just 'BLEU' according to the guidelines
No LLM judges used in this 2020 paper - it predates common LLM-as-judge practices

guideline: Side-by-side comparison of captions with images
Raters shown image with two captions randomly placed left vs right
Absolute rating for each caption (Acceptable, Good, Excellent)

changes_made.explanation: Added explicit criteria 'Acceptability' and 'Quality' based on the rating scale. Removed 'preference' (too vague), 'fluency' and 'accuracy' (not explicitly mentioned as evaluation criteria)

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on image captioning evaluation with human assessments. While automatic metrics are mentioned (BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, CIDEr, SPICE), the authors explicitly state these metrics don't correlate well with human judgments for non-English captioning. Human evaluation is the main evaluation method used.
